data.name: Kamil
data.gender_notes: Kamil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-m-l' which means 'to complete' or 'to perfect'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (God) gives the best of His creations the name Kamil. The name Kamil carries the meaning “Perfect, Complete” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamil usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect, complete and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the completion of a cycle, the attainment of a spiritual goal
data.etymology: Kamil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfect, Complete.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamil total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
